functions.name: aw883xx_init
functions.role: Probe REG0 until chip-id 0x2049; malloc wrapper; run pid_2049_dev_init; install g_aw883xx[dev]

functions.name: aw883xx_pid_2049_dev_init
functions.role: PID-2049 device object + ops vtable; vol_max=0x2D0; bind profiles

functions.name: aw883xx_reg_read
functions.role: 16-bit I2C register read with endian swap via board i2c_read cb

functions.name: aw883xx_reg_write
functions.role: 16-bit I2C register write (BE on wire) via board i2c_write cb

functions.name: aw883xx_dsp_write
functions.role: DSP 16/32-bit write through addr/data regs at device+0x1CC/0x1D0

functions.name: smartpa_set_volume
functions.role: UI level 0..16 → vol_value; TRACE; apply to PA0 then PA1

functions.name: aw883xx_volume_ops
functions.role: Clamp vs vol_max (+0x19C), store +0x1A0, call set_volume op +0x350

functions.name: aw883xx_cali_re_f0
functions.role: Factory cali entry: prepare + re + f0 for one PA

functions.name: smartpa_get_factory_re
functions.role: Read factory Re from both devices (re[0]/re[1] logs)
